name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
description: Gemini 3.8 Flash is an anticipated successor to Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash model. Google's public billing catalogue now lists Gemini API and Vertex AI SKUs, while the model release, capabilities, limits, and callable API identifiers remain unconfirmed.

details.name: availability
details.value: Pre-launch placeholder. Public Google billing SKUs confirm planned Gemini API and Vertex AI pricing, but Google has not confirmed the callable model slug, release, modalities, limits, or capabilities. Phaseo keeps both provider mappings disabled until the official model documentation is published.

page_notice.markdown: Gemini 3.8 Flash is tracked as a pre-launch placeholder. Details and routes remain disabled until Google publishes official documentation.

sources.notes: Google's public billing catalogue contains model-specific Gemini 3.8 Flash SKUs for Gemini API and Vertex AI.

verification.notes: Official Google billing SKUs verify provider-specific pricing. The release, callable model identifiers, capabilities, and limits remain unverified.
